The beach in Florida that allows for alcohol consumption year-round, except in the month of March, is **Madeira Beach**. 

According to multiple sources:
- Madeira Beach permits alcoholic beverages on its beaches throughout the year, making it one of the few beaches in Florida where you can legally drink on the sand outside of the spring break period.
- The only exception to this rule is during March, when alcohol consumption is prohibited.
- This unique policy distinguishes Madeira Beach from most other Florida beaches, which generally ban alcohol on their shores entirely or restrict it during designated periods.
